explication: OLake Go is a data-replication engine: operators run CLI commands to discover source schemas and sync selected streams through full-load, incremental, or CDC paths into Iceberg or Parquet. Source-specific drivers cover databases, Kafka, and S3; shared driver logic coordinates reads and destination writers. Iceberg includes a Java/gRPC writer service, while Parquet supports filesystem and object-store output. The README documents broader catalog support; sampled excerpts and the source index establish only some internal connections, so unverified links are omitted.
